paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构读书小组让协调者敲定一本书，同时允许新成员询问理由。最终决定权与发言机会可以同时存在，六条回答不必一致。偏好这种安排不证明小组实际公平、成员认可或自己属于某种文化；真实安排仍需相关人员讨论确认。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, a fictional reading group lets its coordinator choose a book while newer members can ask why. Final authority and opportunities to speak can coexist; six responses need not align. Preferring this arrangement establishes no actual fairness, acceptance or cultural identity. Participants must discuss the real arrangement.

paragraphs.zh: 可选讨论卡：“只看虚构选书，谁提议、谁能问理由、谁决定，哪些条件还不知道？”可只读，不挑战或服从真实权威。交流者不凭均值给人贴顺从、叛逆或领导力标签，也不把岗位责任直接套成国别文化。
paragraphs.en: An optional discussion card separates proposal, questions, final choice and unknown conditions in the fictional book decision. Reading requires neither challenging nor obeying real authority. A discussion assigns no obedience, rebellion or leadership label from a mean and turns no role responsibility into national culture.

A member preferring a joint topic may still retain private boundaries. A mean rates no selfishness, warmth, independence or loyalty, and the chosen group represents no society.

Valuing care establishes no lack of ambition, and the result rates no gender traits, ability or worth.

paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, an ambiguous fictional group message leaves one member wanting clarification and another willing to retain two meanings. Both still check the agreed meeting time. Handling ambiguity differs from following a concrete requirement. The mean rates no courage, anxiety, risk-taking or rule compliance.

Discussion creates no uncertainty to test tolerance, requires no ignored safety requirement and interprets no clarification request as a psychological problem.

A present preference establishes no foresight, planning skill or achievement and waives no commitment.

Another prefers a norm emphasizing duty while still enjoying the break. Preferred arrangements and actual feelings remain separate; means judge no happiness, discipline, spending impulses or life balance, and rest opportunities need not be equal.

paragraphs.en: An optional discussion card separates agreed responsibility, optional enjoyment and individual participation choices in the fictional break. Reading needs no lifestyle change or purchase. Discussion requires no proof of deserving rest, declares no duty finished from a score and assigns no national or personal value hierarchy to restraint or enjoyment.
